_comment: Optional. Copy to courses.json and edit. Keys are an LMS course id or a course code ("CSCI 1301"). Every field is optional. Classes are found in the library by folders named after their code ("CSCI1301 Notes", "CSCI 1301", ...) unless `folders` lists them. A key that matches no LMS course adds a library-only class. Icons: atom brain briefcase calculator code dna flask globe landmark languages music palette pen scale sigma.
